description: This source file implements the PTMCoreMLCompiler class, which provides methods to manage CoreML model compilation, caching, loading, and configuration within an iOS/macOS environment. It includes platform-specific code for iOS, handling cache directories, model compilation, version checks, and model loading with different compute units and low-precision settings.

classes.name: PTMCoreMLCompiler
classes.description: A utility class for handling CoreML model compilation, cache management, and loading, specifically tailored for iOS and macOS platforms, with platform-specific code for iOS.

methods.name: setCacheDirectory
methods.description: Sets the cache directory for storing compiled models, converting a std::string to NSString.

methods.name: cacheDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current cache directory, defaulting to temporary directory if not set or not writable.

methods.name: compileModel:modelID:
methods.description: Compiles a CoreML model from specifications if not cached for the current OS version.

methods.name: loadModel:backend:allowLowPrecision:error:
methods.description: Loads a compiled CoreML model with specified backend and low precision options, handling errors and cache cleanup.

methods.name: _writeModelSpecs:toPath:
methods.description: Writes model specifications (protobuf data) to a file at given path.

methods.name: _compileModel:atPath:
methods.description: Compiles a model at local file URL, updates cache, and timestamp files with OS version.

methods.name: _cleanupCachedModel:
methods.description: Removes cached model and version files for a given model name.

methods.name: _cacheURLForModel:extension:
methods.description: Generates a URL for cached model or version files based on model ID and extension.
